home.tagline: Full stack developer, manager and nutritionist located in Sweden ✨

about.whoBody: I'm a Full stack developer, and my interest in programming started during the pandemic in 2020. As a side project, I created a HealthTech product called Nutreto - a cloud-based platform for nutrition and health. This turned into a passion for web development, and a career change.
about.firstJobPost: product for synthetic data generation . There was no other frontend developer in the entire company, so I created a frontend application from scratch using modern web technologies (JavaScript, React, Styled components and Jest).
about.currentJob: ⸺ My current job as a Frontend developer
about.currentJobPost: - a start-up for buying, selling and leasing electrified vehicles online. We use Next.js, TypeScript and React for the app, as well as Jest and Cypress for testing. The static content is served via Contentful and the API layer uses GraphQL.
about.initiative1: I pushed myself and my team at Carla to convert the entire codebase from JavaScript to TypeScript.
about.initiative2: I created a female engineering club to discuss problems and solutions within the company and the tech world in general.
about.initiative3: During the last year, I've set aside 1 "study hour" each day to deepen my web development knowledge.
about.interestsBody: I'm passionate about tech, leadership, change management, process improvement and teamwork. I'm also always curious to learn new things. I'm a well-organized person, a problem solver, and I like to create modular, readable and testable code which is easy to maintain and extend.

PORTFOLIO.title: This portfolio
PORTFOLIO.text: I could have created this portfolio with some online template or no-code solution - but I didn't want to do that 🤓 Instead, I've used this portfolio as a way to showcase my skills and way of coding. Look at GitHub, you'll find a well-organized, linted and strictly formatted project with my own custom theme structure.

CAT_BREEDS_APP.title: Cat Breeds app
CAT_BREEDS_APP.text: It's no secret that I love cats 😻 When I applied to the role as a Frontend developer at Carla, I created this cat breeds app. I wanted to show a part of who I am, but also - of course - my programming skills. The project also has a few tests just to showcase how I usually structure them.
CAT_BREEDS_APP.technologies: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Styled components, Jest.
